subject: MAP Draft & Integration Build Plan - FinPay
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@finpay.com>, Carlos Menendez <carlos.menendez@finpay.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-22T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Draft & Integration Build Plan - FinPay

Hi Sana / Carlos —

Thanks again for the intro call today. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a focused milestone for the Integration Build Plan. High level recap and next steps below.

Call recap (quick):
- Goal: integrate Redwood Inference SDK for real-time payment-recommendation generation (streaming responses + structured outputs) into FinPay checkout flow.
- Success metrics: <=250ms median token latency for recommendations, 95th pct under 600ms, cost target <$0.002 per recommendation.

Attached: FinPay_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP) and integration-build-checklist.xlsx (detailed checklist).

Integration Build Plan (milestone excerpt):
1) SDK integration (client side) — Owner: FinPay (Carlos) / Redwood SRE support (Vivek)
   - Tasks: import SDK, auth token handling, connection pooling, retries.
   - Target complete: 2026-04-08
   - Dependencies: internal FinPay staging env, API key provisioning, CORS allowed origins.
2) Streaming responses (server-side pipeline) — Owner: Redwood (Rishi) / FinPay backend (devops@finpay.com)
   - Tasks: enable streaming endpoints, test chunk assembly, fallbacks for long prompts.
   - Target complete: 2026-04-15
   - Dependencies: staging load test window, agreed SLOs for timeouts.
3) Tool calling & webhooks (order validation) — Owner: FinPay (Sana) / Redwood (Marissa)
   - Tasks: define tool schema, webhook contract, error-handling semantics.
   - Target complete: 2026-04-22
   - Dependencies: FinPay tool API mock, contract doc sign-off.
4) Structured outputs (JSON schema for recommendation) — Owner: Redwood (Vivek) / FinPay PM (Carlos)
   - Tasks: finalize schema, add validation, map to checkout UI fields.
   - Target complete: 2026-04-18
   - Dependencies: UI field availability, mapping doc

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Carlos: confirm owners above and add any missing FinPay stakeholders by Tue 2026-03-24.
- DevOps: grant a staging API key + CORS list (see attachment for required scopes).
- Rishi / Vivek: can you review the technical milestones and flag any Redwood-side scheduling conflicts?

I’ll update the attached MAP with any changes and push to the shared Drive link. Happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up to walk through the integration checklist.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: FinPay_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, integration-build-checklist.xlsx, sdk-integration-snippets.zip

From: Carlos Menendez <carlos.menendez@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@finpay.com>
Cc: devops@finpay.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-23T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft & Integration Build Plan - FinPay

Marissa — thanks for the clear write-up and the MAP. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Owners: I'll own SDK integration (with our frontend lead Pilar copied offline), Sana will own tool contract and product decisions.
- DevOps (devops@finpay.com) will scope the staging env this week.
- Dates look reasonable; we may need to shift one week for structured outputs if UI team needs extra time, but will confirm by Friday.

I'll loop in Pilar and our infra lead if we need deeper technical syncs. For now, please proceed with Redwood-side scheduling for streaming & tool call work.

Best,
Carlos
Director of Product, FinPay
carlos.menendez@finpay.com

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-23T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft & Integration Build Plan - FinPay

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the milestones. A few technical notes from the infra/SE side:
- Streaming: we can support the streaming endpoint by 2026-04-15 but need a 48-72 hour load test window in staging during the week of 2026-04-06. Please coordinate with FinPay DevOps.
- Auth: recommend short-lived service tokens + rotating key pattern; I'll attach sample auth flow in the Drive link.
- Tool calling: suggest we prototype using a simple webhook ack flow first (no heavy retries) to validate contract before adding complex idempotency.

I'll put tentative calendar blocks on my calendar for integration checkpoints (design review 4/7, load test 4/10).

-Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: devops@finpay.com, Carlos Menendez <carlos.menendez@finpay.com>, Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@finpay.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-24T08:53:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft & Integration Build Plan - FinPay

Hi all — looping in FinPay DevOps to request the staging items Rishi called out. DevOps, quick checklist from Redwood:
- Create a staging API key with scopes: inference:stream, inference:metadata, webhooks:send
- Add dev.redwood.ai to CORS allowed origins for the staging env
- Provision a short-lived staging cluster for the load test window (we'll coordinate exact hours)

Carlos — noted on potential shift for structured outputs. If the UI team needs the extra week, we can push structured outputs target to 2026-04-25 and keep streaming & SDK targets as-is to preserve an earlier validation run. Please confirm by EOD Friday.

Also attaching the current MAP on Drive; I've added a comment to the tool-calling row for the webhook contract template.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@finpay.com>

Subject: Re: MAP Draft & Integration Build Plan - FinPay

Marissa / team — thanks for the MAP and the clear owners. Quick confirmations:
- Owners: confirmed (Carlos = SDK, Sana = product/tooling, DevOps = infra).
- Dates: we will keep streaming and SDK targets; structured outputs moved to 2026-04-25 as discussed.
- DevOps will provision the staging API key and CORS by 2026-03-27.

Next steps:
1) Marissa: update MAP with structured outputs moved to 2026-04-25 and upload new version to Drive.
2) Rishi: confirm calendar invites for design review (2026-04-07) and load test (2026-04-10).
3) Carlos / Pilar: share frontend integration window so Redwood can plan sanity checks.

Happy to take a 30-min sync on Monday if helpful.

Regards,
